title: Walsh characters under projection away from fixed coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $\gamma$ be a binary vector indexed by the complement of $J$, and let $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Project $x$ onto the coordinates outside $J$, in the ordering used to identify that complement with a finite coordinate set, and lift $\gamma$ to a vector in $\mathbb F_2^n$ by extending its corresponding frequency vector by zero on $J$. The Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ evaluated at the projection of $x$ equals the Walsh character indexed by this lifted vector evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A binary vector indexed by the complement of $J$
